spaces.title: Art, Architecture, and Engineering Library Floor 2 Computing Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Connect to an external monitor or work with a group at a VizHub in this mixed seating space.
spaces.imageAlt: Students working individually at a set of tables with external monitors and short privacy dividers..

spaces.title: Art, Architecture, and Engineering Library Floor 2 Lobby Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Natural light brightens this space with seating at tables amongst a variety of low profile stacks.
spaces.imageAlt: Aerial view of stacks, seating, and students in the Art, Architecture, and Engineering Library.

spaces.title: Art, Architecture, and Engineering Library Floor 2 Stacks Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Find a quiet spot among the stacks or in a tucked away corner window.
spaces.imageAlt: Students sitting high-backed wooden chairs at a bar height counter facing windows.

spaces.title: Art, Architecture, and Engineering Library Floor 3 Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Choose from a variety of seating options, including study pods and large tables.
spaces.imageAlt: Students working at a long rectangular table next to book stacks with a whiteboard behind them and windows in the distance.

spaces.title: Asia Library Reading Room
spaces.bodySummary: A mixture of seating and the Oka Tadoku Room make up this cozy, light-filled space in Hatcher North.
spaces.imageAlt: Students using seating in the Tadoku Room with laptops and booths in the background

spaces.title: Bert's Study Lounge
spaces.bodySummary: A café-like atmosphere with mixed seating, good for individual study or group meetings.
spaces.imageAlt: Students studying at high and low tables with windows in the background.

spaces.title: Clark Commons Collaborative Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: An open and active space with lots of light and a mix of seating options for individual and group study.
spaces.imageAlt: A view of the Clark Commons Living Room with students along counter seating in foreground and seated throughout the space

spaces.title: Clark Commons Computing Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Seating areas with a mix of external monitor options, plus a campus computing site.
spaces.imageAlt: Students working at tables with extended display monitors

spaces.title: Clark Library Seating Area
spaces.bodySummary: Couches, armchairs, and tables between windows and exhibit cases.
spaces.imageAlt: Students studying at rectangular tables in comfy chairs alongside windows.

spaces.title: Duderstadt Center Interview Rooms
spaces.bodySummary: Small rooms you can book up to 3 days in advance.
spaces.imageAlt: Small table with two office chairs and wall-mounted whiteboard.

spaces.title: Fine Arts Library Carrels
spaces.bodySummary: Reserved for graduate students in history of art.
spaces.imageAlt: Student working on their laptop at an open carrel surrounded by stacks of books.

spaces.title: Fine Arts Library Floor 2
spaces.bodySummary: High ceilings and tables surrounded by books.
spaces.imageAlt: Open space with windows and students scattered, sitting around large wooden stables.

spaces.title: Hatcher Floor 6 Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Lounge-like study areas with views of the Law Quad and Michigan Stadium.
spaces.imageAlt: Open space with tables along the windows and a few students studying.

spaces.title: Hatcher North 212A
spaces.bodySummary: Glassed-in space near the center of the floor for solo or small group work.
spaces.imageAlt: Glassed in space along a wall with a table, five chairs, and wall-mounted screen. Computers and entrance to Hatcher South are in the background.

spaces.title: Hatcher North Floor 2 Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: An open floor with a range of seating options and regular traffic passing through.
spaces.imageAlt: Open, high traffic area with large tables on the side for studying.

spaces.title: Hatcher North Stacks Study Tables
spaces.bodySummary: Out-of-the-way spots in the book stacks on 7 different floors.
spaces.imageAlt: Students sitting at rectangular tables along a wall next to floor-to-ceiling book stacks.

spaces.title: Hatcher Reference Reading Room
spaces.bodySummary: Historic space in Hatcher North that's well-known for quiet, individual study.
spaces.imageAlt: Wide view of the iconic reading room with large windows, students at long tables, and a mural in the distance.

spaces.title: Hatcher South Bookable Daily Carrels
spaces.bodySummary: Cubicles for one that can be reserved in advance.
spaces.imageAlt: Chair and work surface in a study carrel with a window and trees outside, there's a sign outside the entrance that it's bookable.

spaces.title: Hatcher South Bookable Weekly Carrels
spaces.bodySummary: Donor-furnished cubicles for individual study that can be reserved for up to a week.
spaces.imageAlt: Study carrels with doors, but the walls do not go to the ceiling.

spaces.title: Hatcher South Designated SSD Carrels
spaces.bodySummary: Designated, enclosed carrels for Services for Students with Disabilities connected students.
spaces.imageAlt: Door with Reserved - Office of SSD sign ajar into a room with a chair, desk, and windows with a view of campus.

spaces.title: Hatcher South Long-term Research Carrels
spaces.bodySummary: Semester-long carrel reservations for U-M graduate students and faculty.
spaces.imageAlt: Close-up of a person sitting at the table in a carrel reading a book.

spaces.title: Hatcher South Open Carrels
spaces.bodySummary: Cubicles for one with a desk and window.
spaces.imageAlt: A row of carrels with no doors to the left and stacks on the right.

spaces.title: International Studies Reading Room
spaces.bodySummary: A small, tucked away reading room for individual or group study near the Hatcher North lobby.
spaces.imageAlt: Open room with high ceilings, large pane windows, and tables with movable chairs.

spaces.title: Music Library Carrels
spaces.bodySummary: Intended for advanced research and writing.
spaces.imageAlt: View from behind of sitting in a carrel in the Music Library with scores on the shelf in front of them.

spaces.title: Music Library Floors 3 and 4
spaces.bodySummary: A quiet airy space with tables with a mix of seating for individuals and groups.
spaces.imageAlt: View from the top of two floors with an opening in the middle. The ground floor has rectangular tables and low bookshelves, the top floor has a railing and armchairs.

spaces.title: Shapiro Basement Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Movable tables and chairs in open areas, plus a CAEN Lab.
spaces.imageAlt: Students studying at tables in the basement of the Shapiro Library

spaces.title: Shapiro Bookable Study Rooms
spaces.bodySummary: Rooms for groups on the second and third floors with adjustable tables, rolling chairs, and whiteboards.
spaces.imageAlt: View into a hallway of group study rooms with windows on the upper half of the walls.

spaces.title: Shapiro Floor 1 Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: A large open area with a variety of seating options and tables, plus vending machines.
spaces.imageAlt: A movable whiteboard and students working at tables on a big open floor.

spaces.title: Shapiro Floor 2 Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Rectangular tables and wooden chairs for working in groups or alone near others.
spaces.imageAlt: Students studying at long rectangular tables with a movable whiteboard in view and a window in the background.

spaces.title: Shapiro Floor 4 Spaces
spaces.bodySummary: Table seating, mostly in windowed nooks, on a quieter floor that’s good for working alone.
spaces.imageAlt: Round tables separated by partitions into individual work areas with windows in the background.

spaces.title: Shapiro Reading Room
spaces.bodySummary: Long tables with padded chairs and a mix of other seating, all for individual, focused study.
spaces.imageAlt: Students studying at long tables in the Shapiro Reading Room with a sunbeam coming through the window

spaces.title: Soundproof Booths
spaces.bodySummary: Reservable booths for sound privacy.
spaces.imageAlt: Student seated inside a tall soundproof booth with a transparent door

spaces.title: Student Parent and Caregiver Study Room
spaces.bodySummary: A study room for student parents and caregivers.
spaces.imageAlt: A wall with a jungle mural, high back chairs, child-size desk, little free library lending book shelves, and table with a shared display.

spaces.title: Taubman Health Sciences Library Study Space
spaces.bodySummary: A wide variety of seating options, plus computing, in a light-filled space for focused work.
spaces.imageAlt: Open and deep space full of students working.
